WITH grp AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
         s.healtheval AS health_status,
         AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_per_min,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  WHERE sc.chronotag::text >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND sc.chronotag::text <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) AS mean_avg FROM grp
)
SELECT g.site_code,
       g.health_status,
       g.avg_gb_per_min,
       g.scan_count,
       g.avg_gb_per_min - st.mean_avg AS beat_by
FROM grp g
CROSS JOIN stats st
WHERE g.avg_gb_per_min > st.mean_avg
ORDER BY beat_by DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
